# MenuTrigger

`Flare.Components.Combobox.MenuTrigger`

What user gesture opens the dropdown.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Click` | `0` | Opens on a pointer click / Enter / Space / Arrow on the trigger (select-only pattern). |
| `Input` | `1` | Opens as the user types in an editable input (combobox pattern). |
| `Focus` | `2` | Opens as soon as the trigger gains focus. |
| `Manual` | `3` | Never opens on its own; the host drives Open explicitly. |
